origin.location: Changes affecting both male & female questionnaires, p. 1
origin.note: Quote: Revised marital and cohabiting status questions (Section A) to be more inclusive of same-sex spouses and partners. ... MARSTAT now asks about spouse/partner regardless of sex

note: wording_changed is what the summary states. codes_changed is from the two codebooks: 1-6 (married, cohabiting, widowed, divorced, separated, never married) in 2017-2019; 1-3 (married, living together, neither) in 2022-2023.
